svg.title: How far past the rim red's reply throws blue, for every blue move
svg.desc: Six panels, one per blue arm. The horizontal axis is blue's stop angle, the vertical axis is how far blue's worst foot ends beyond the rim after red's (0,−) reply. A thin line is the engine at sampled stops; filled steps are proved lower bounds from Taylor-model cells. Every value is above zero.
svg.text: How far past the rim red's reply throws blue
Blue's worst foot, in board units beyond the rim, after red's (0,−) reply. Line: engine samples. Steps: proved lower bounds.
